title: DDU B.Tech Odd Semester End-Term Examination Schedule Dec 2026 Announced
short_description: Final university examination timetable released for 1st, 3rd, 5th, and 7th Semester regular and carry-over students.
full_details: The Controller of Examinations, Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gorakhpur University has notified that Odd Semester theory examinations shall begin on December 15, 2026. Students must verify shifts, reporting times, and assigned campus examination centers. Admit cards will be active on the portal 7 days prior to commencement.

title: Revised Academic Ordinance & Curriculum Guidelines for B.Tech CSE (AI & ML)
short_description: Department of Computer Science & Engineering releases updated specialization modules for Machine Learning and GenAI.
full_details: The Academic Council of DDU Gorakhpur University has approved updated course structures aligning with National Education Policy (NEP) and industry AI standards. Students can access the verified syllabus PDF directly from the syllabus section.

title: Even Semester 2026 Regular & Back Paper Examination Results Declared
short_description: Results for 2nd, 4th, 6th, and 8th semester B.Tech students are officially live on the university examination portal.
full_details: Students seeking challenge evaluation or scrutiny verification may submit applications within 15 days from this publication date. Grade sheets will be distributed to respective dean offices shortly.

title: Online Admit Card Release Notice for Special Carry Over Examinations
short_description: Admit cards for students registered in special back-paper exams are now active for download and verification.
full_details: Ensure subject codes, student photograph, and college stamp are legible. Discrepancies should be reported immediately to the Examination Cell.

title: Upload of Unit 1 to 5 Comprehensive Notes for Operating Systems, DBMS & DAA
short_description: Verified high-yield lecture notes and solved numerical question banks for 4th and 5th semester courses have been published.
full_details: Curated by engineering faculty members, these notes include derivations, algorithmic traces, and high-frequency university exam problems.

title: Previous 5 Years Question Papers (2021-2025) Uploaded for All Semesters
short_description: Complete archive of DDU B.Tech End-Semester question papers from 2021 to 2025 is now available for download.
full_details: Engineering students across all branches can filter papers by semester, year, and subject to prepare systematically for upcoming end-term examinations.

title: University Circular: Guidelines for Submission of 8th Semester Major Capstone Projects
short_description: Final year B.Tech students must submit synopsis, project code repository links, and guide-approved draft reports.
full_details: Presentations will be scheduled in front of external examiners. Anti-plagiarism screening will be mandatory prior to final viva-voce examination.

title: University Holiday Notice: Mahayogi Gorakhnath Jayanti Celebration
short_description: Administrative offices and teaching departments of DDU Gorakhpur University will remain closed on the auspicious occasion.
full_details: Normal instructional classes will resume on the subsequent working day. Central Library reading halls will remain open with holiday hours.

title: Samsung Innovation Campus (SIC) AI/ML & IoT Certification at DDU Gorakhpur University
short_description: Department of Computer Science & Engineering successfully executes the Samsung Innovation Campus (SIC) program with over 300 students certified.
full_details: In collaboration with Samsung Electronics Southwest Asia and NIELIT, students of DDU B.Tech CSE participated in rigorous industry-led training in Artificial Intelligence, Coding, Big Data, and IoT. Felicitations were graced by the Honourable Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath Ji and Samsung CEO. Notable topper Mr. Amit Maurya was awarded ₹1 Lakh cash prize and laptop.

title: Official Release of CBCS & NEP 2020 Curricula for B.Tech CSE (AI/ML) & AI & DS Specializations
short_description: Faculty of Engineering & Technology, DDUGU Gorakhpur officially releases updated credit schemes and syllabi for session 2024-2026.
full_details: The Academic Council has approved the specialized curricula for B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning and B.Tech in AI & Data Science. Curricula include 34 NPTEL elective courses and industry internship modules.

title: Inauguration of Specialized Computing Infrastructure: AI/ML, Cloud IoT & Cyber Forensics Labs
short_description: State-of-the-art laboratory facilities inaugurated at the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, DDUGU.
full_details: Equipped with modern high-performance GPU nodes and networked computing clusters to support undergraduate B.Tech research, capstone projects, and real-time model training.

title: GATE 2025/2026 Academic Mentorship Sessions Announced for B.Tech Engineering Students
short_description: Department of Computer Science faculty to conduct dedicated weekend problem-solving sessions for GATE aspirants.
full_details: Building on the stellar 2025 GATE results where 12 students qualified with the highest All India Rank of 120, specialized coaching on Algorithms, COA, Theory of Computation, and Compiler Design will be organized by department faculty.

title: Urgent: Library Reading Room Extended Hours for End-Sem Exam Prep
short_description: Central Library will remain open 24x7 during examination weeks.
full_details: Special quiet study zones and high-speed Wi-Fi access available for all B.Tech students.
